feedback.problem:
Given 
$D=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}]$,
 which of the following elementary row operations makes ${a}_{31}=0?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation 

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1}.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 0 & -7 & 5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1}.
$$
